{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
total_rows = len(sales)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Total rows: {total_rows}")
print(f"QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(f"QA orders in %: {len(qa_orders) / total_rows * 100:.1f}%")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = len(sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded'])
print(f"Refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Check the unique values in channel and customer_segment
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(sales['channel'].value_counts())
print("\nCustomer segment distribution:")
print(sales['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Inspect the revenue column: confirm it's string and has commas
print("\nFirst few revenue values (as string):")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("\nCount of customer_age == -1:")
print(sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_age'].count())"}
